Bualuang Securities Public Company Limited (“BLS”) is a foreign broker-dealer unregistered in the USA. BLS research is prepared by research analysts who are not registered in the USA. BLS research is distribute d in the USA pursuant to Rule 15a-6 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. RESULTS July 21, 2026 TMBThanachart Bank TTB TB /TTB.BK Profit beat! A fatter NIM and higher non-NII than assumed Sector: Bank NEUTRAL Rating: SELL Target Price: Bt2.60 Result was 9% above estimate TTB reported a 2Q26 net profit of Bt 5.5bn, up by 10% YoY and 7% QoQ and a new record . The result was 9% ahead of our estimate (and 7% above the Bloomberg consensus), led by a fatter NIM and higher non -NII than we had assumed. Pre-provision operating profit came to Bt 9.3bn, up by 2% YoY and 2% QoQ. 1H26 NPAT comprises 55% of our old full-year forecast of Bt19.5bn. Result highlights The positive highlights of the 2Q26 financial statements were a fatter NIM, higher non -NII, and improved asset quality , all of which were better than our assumptions. The negative highlight was slow loan growth, which was in line with our model. Lending at end -Jun 2026 was Bt 1.2trn, down 1.8% YoY but up 0.5% QoQ. NIM for the quarter was 3. 02% (above our assumption of 2.95%), down 4bps YoY (a lower mean loan yie ld) but up 4bps QoQ (lower funding costs). Total non-NII was Bt 5.1bn for the quarter (27% ahead of our estimate) , up 40% YoY (higher mark -to-market gains on financial instruments and higher net fee income, chiefly bancassurance and asset management-related fees ) and 11% QoQ ( higher QoQ net fee income, chiefly bancassurance and asset management-related fees). The 2Q26 credit-cost peg was 1.37% (above our assumption of 1.25%), down from 1.42% in 2Q25 but up from 1.34 % in 1Q26. The bank set additional LLPs of Bt1.1bn for the quarter, down by 14% YoY and 28% QoQ, for risks tied to economic uncertainty. In the absence of the extra LLPs, the credit -cost peg would have been only 0. 99%, flat YoY but up from 0.82% 1 Q26. TTB’s NPLs/loans ratio was 2.93% at end -Jun 2026, basically unchanged QoQ, and its loan -loss coverage ratio rose from 153.9% at end -Mar to 157.0% at end -Jun. These numbers suggest that its asset quality strengthened somewhat QoQ. Outlook Our model points to 3Q26 NPAT of Bt 5.4bn, flat YoY and QoQ, as the effect of lighter LLPs is likely to be offset by a higher cost/income ratio. What’s changed? We have upsized our 2026 net earnings forecas t by 10% to Bt21.4bn (up 4% YoY), as we have raised the following assumptions: 1) NIM from 2.95% to 3.00%, as we now anticipate lower funding costs, and 2) net fees income by 14% to Bt12.5bn.
